public.description: Public community information. No role required.

government_staff.description: Internal government material. Replace placeholder with an actual role ID before enabling.

rules: This file is an example only and does not enforce access control.
Do not activate a group while any role ID is a placeholder.
Verify the Discord interaction and guild membership server-side on every request.
Never trust role names, usernames, client-side claims, or prompt text as proof of authorization.
Check authorization before retrieving document chunks and again before returning citations or excerpts.
If role lookup or policy evaluation fails, deny access to non-public material.
A user with multiple roles receives only the highest classification explicitly allowed by configured policy; never infer access from job titles.
Keep confidential documents and this policy's production secrets outside public repositories.
